description: Normal (non-bot) OAuth connections: fetch the project key local test runners (Playwright reporter, CLI, k6) need. Returns {projectId, projectName, projectApiKey, userId, backendUrl, ingressUrl} for the project named by the projectId argument, or by projectApiKey (which also tells you a key-only file's projectId); without either, the connection's default project (the MCP URL's ?projectId= when set, else the one picked on the consent page). To persist the runner key without putting it in a shell command: local stdio MCP should call save-workspace-creds; hosted / plugin agents should write <repo>/.testchimp/creds.json themselves (mode 0600, dir 0700) from this response and never print projectApiKey. This tool still returns projectApiKey for those callers. Not needed with an API key (stdio already has it).
name: get-project-credentials
title: Get Project Credentials
